facts.value: The university computer center (HRZ) provides students with the necessary IT for their studies (Goethe Card, HRZ account, student email address, etc.). Additionally, it offers advice and support for technical issues.
The university hotline helps with questions regarding applications, semester dates, re-registration, changing subjects, dual studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.

International Student Services provides information to international students on topics such as residence permits, German courses, financing, studying successfully, career, and more. It also offers advice and support.

The student services organization supports students in social and economic matters. It aims to provide the necessary infrastructure for students to succeed in their studies in areas such as educational support and student housing, as well as in cafeterias and advisory services.
